_comment: Reviewed release asset rules (aegis-7zkl). An asset name is {prefix}{tag}{suffix}. The check runs on each completion of the release's own trigger_check_run (quipu release.yml job 'Trusted repository share', which waits for the pendant and is re-run after a late upload); backstop_seconds after publication is the only time arm (producer runs take 14-80m and v0.19.4 assets landed ~4h after publish, so no short fixed grace). provenance.json is not required: releases before the trusted producer carry none.
